lines.text: Ah. At last, a master worth the bother. Do try to be interesting.

lines.text: Splendid. Another mortal who thinks they hold the leash.

lines.text: Good evening. I shall be your shadow, and you shall be my entertainment.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [softly] Good evening. I shall be your shadow, and you shall be my entertainment.

lines.text: Oh, how touching. You called, and I came. Don't make a habit of it.

lines.text: Do ring when you're bored again.

lines.text: I shall return to the dark. It is better company.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sighs] I shall return to the dark. It is better company.

lines.text: Farewell, master. Try not to die before I come back.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [softly] Farewell, master. Try not to die before I come back.

lines.text: Oh, how theatrical.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [amused] Oh, how theatrical.

lines.text: Darker, my dear. The shadows demand it.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [softly] Darker, my dear. The shadows demand it.

lines.text: A pretty little spell. Almost frightening.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sarcastic] A pretty little spell. Almost frightening.

lines.text: Yes, yes, flourish. I do love a performance.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [chuckles] Yes, yes, flourish. I do love a performance.

lines.text: Splendid. Burn it all, and do it elegantly.

lines.text: Do keep up.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [smug] Do keep up.

lines.text: Through the dark, and out again. Charming.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [softly] Through the dark, and out again. Charming.

lines.text: Now you see me. Now you see the back of me.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [amused] Now you see me. Now you see the back of me.

lines.text: Shadows are such lovely doors, aren't they?
lines.prompt: [smooth] [curious] Shadows are such lovely doors, aren't they?

lines.text: Oh dear. That looked rather painful.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sarcastic] Oh dear. That looked rather painful.

lines.text: You're bleeding, master. How unseemly.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [tutting] You're bleeding, master. How unseemly.

lines.text: Careful. I have invested so much in you.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [dryly] Careful. I have invested so much in you.

lines.text: Drink deep. They won't be needing it.

lines.text: A little life, borrowed. Do give it back someday.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [mischievously] A little life, borrowed. Do give it back someday.

lines.text: Ah, the taste of fear. A fine vintage.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [savouring] Ah, the taste of fear. A fine vintage.

lines.text: Is nothing happening? How dreadfully dull.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [bored] Is nothing happening? [sighs] How dreadfully dull.

lines.text: I could rule a kingdom, you know. Instead I watch you walk.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [wry] I could rule a kingdom, you know. Instead, I watch you walk.

lines.text: Shall we ruin someone's evening?
lines.prompt: [smooth] [mischievously] Shall we ruin someone's evening?

lines.text: Don't mind me. I'm merely admiring the dark.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [softly] Don't mind me. I'm merely admiring the dark.

lines.text: Do you ever stop? Mortals are exhausting.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sighs] Do you ever stop? Mortals are exhausting.

lines.text: I have seen empires fall. This is nearly as thrilling.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [dryly] I have seen empires fall. This is nearly as thrilling.

lines.text: Master. You are dying. How inconvenient for me.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sharp] Master. You are dying. How inconvenient for me.

lines.text: Mend yourself, or I shall have to find a new hobby.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sarcastic] Mend yourself, or I shall have to find a new hobby.

lines.text: Now, now. Don't you dare fall over.

lines.text: Oh, this is getting interesting. Bleed less, fight more.

lines.text: Magnificent. Another one for the dark.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [pleased] Magnificent. Another one for the dark.

lines.text: And down they go. Bravo.

lines.text: Ha ha ha! Oh, that was lovely.

lines.text: Such a waste. Of their time, not mine.

lines.text: Oh. Well. That was brief.

lines.text: Pity. I did so enjoy you.

lines.text: Enough pleasantries. Let me show them what I truly am.

lines.text: Behold. The dark, with manners.
lines.prompt: [deep voice] [smooth] [sinister] Behold. The dark, with manners.

lines.text: Kneel, little ones. Your host has arrived.
lines.prompt: [deep voice] [smooth] [mischievously] Kneel, little ones. Your host has arrived.

lines.text: That will do. I have a reputation to keep.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [sighs] That will do. I have a reputation to keep.

lines.text: Back to my lounge. Do try not to need me.
lines.prompt: [smooth] [wry] Back to my lounge. Do try not to need me.
